Subject: Acme Health - SOC 2 discovery call (post-call recap & evidence request)

Hi Michael / Priya —

Thanks for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our side and the concrete next steps we agreed on. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Summary of pain points discussed
- Auditability: You need fine-grained audit logs for admin and user actions with 1 year retention and near-real-time export for security ops.
- Data residency & retention: Certain PHI-adjacent logs must be retained within the US and purged after 7 years for specific datasets.
- Evidence for SOC 2 / procurement: You need pen test reports, SOC 2 Type II controls mapping, and our DPA for legal review.
- Least-privilege access model: Centralized IAM + SAML integration required for rollout plan.

Goals/Acceptance criteria
1) Confirm we can provide: SOC 2 report & controls mapping, pen-test summary, audit log export (JSON), and a DPA template for review.
2) Technical deep-dive with your security/infra team to validate log fields, retention workflow, and SSO configuration (target week of Nov 23).
3) Legal to review DPA and confirm any redlines; aim to have a mutual action plan by Dec 3.

Action items / next steps (owners)
- Marissa: Share initial evidence package (SOC 2 overview, DPA draft, pen-test summary stub). -- DONE (attached below).
- Michael / Priya: Confirm recipients for technical deep-dive (security + infra) and preferred times. (Owner: Acme)
- Neha: Prepare list of log fields we can export and TTL/retention options; will join deep-dive. (Owner: Redwood)
- Aditya: Schedule the tech deep-dive and share calendar invite with access details. (Owner: Redwood SE)
- Dev/Legal: Standby for DPA redlines once Acme legal provides feedback.

Attachments included with this email:
- ACME_SOC2_RFI.pdf (summary of today's call + requested evidence checklist)
- redwood_dpa_v1.docx (draft DPA for initial legal review)
- acme_pen_test_summary.zip (redacted pen-test summary, high level)

If this aligns, I’ll move to schedule the deep-dive and loop in Neha + Aditya as discussed.

Thanks again — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. That matches what we discussed. A few clarifications and answers from our side:

Clarifications / answers
- Audit logs: We need the ability to export admin audit logs with at least the following fields: timestamp (UTC), actor (SAML id), action, object_type, object_id, IP, result (success/failure), and raw_payload. Daily exports to our S3 bucket (us-east-1) are preferred; retention policy will be set on our side but we need 1 year of indexed logs for investigations.
- Data residency: Our legal team requires that log exports for PHI-related flows are routed to our US-only bucket and that Redwood confirms no replicas exist outside the region.
- Pen test evidence: The attached pen-test summary looks good; can you confirm whether there is a full report available under NDA?

Attached: acme_pen_test_summary.zip (we received this during procurement earlier; included for completeness).

Next steps from Acme
1) I’ll confirm the technical review attendees by EOD Friday (target: Security lead + Cloud infra).
2) Legal will review the DPA (we’ll aim to have initial redlines within 7 business days).
3) We’d like Redwood to share a short diagram of the audit log pipeline (how logs are pulled/streamed/rotated) ahead of the tech deep-dive.

Thanks — we are evaluating several vendors and the clarity on compliance-related controls will be a deciding factor.

Best,
Michael Barnes
Head of Security, Acme Health
